info.title: Good Neighbor Backend Tools
info.description: Community waste-recovery tools: surplus listings, resource catalog, recipient needs, pantry levels, volunteers, vehicles, and donation guidelines. Backed by the deployed good-neighbor-backend Lambda + HTTP API.

get.description: Returns surplus food and goods that donor organizations have posted as available for recovery.
Returns the categories of food and goods circulating in the community network. Optional filters.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by category, e.g. produce, bakery, canned.

get.description: Returns what food banks, shelters, and partner organizations are currently requesting. Optional filters.

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: Filter needs by a specific resource id, e.g. RES001.

parameters.name: org_id
parameters.description: Filter needs by a specific recipient organization id, e.g. ORG001.

get.description: Returns current stock levels at partner food banks and pantries, with a computed low-stock flag. Optional resource filter.

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: Filter pantry levels by a specific resource id, e.g. RES001.

get.description: Returns volunteer drivers, their location and availability. Optional filters.

parameters.name: available
parameters.description: Set to true to return only currently available volunteers.

get.summary: Get vehicles for pickups and deliveries
get.description: Returns vehicles with type, capacity, location, and maintenance status. Optional filters.

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: Filter by capacity class: car, van, or box truck.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by vehicle type (contains search), e.g. refrigerated.

get.description: Returns donation and food-safety guideline text for a given type.

parameters.name: guideline_type
parameters.description: Which guideline to retrieve: Acceptance, Window, or Handling.
